specifications.basis: Burner Management Systems are implemented in two general types of platforms. The most common for utilities is in a plant wide Distributive Control System (DCS). Less common but just as reliable is a Programmable Logic Controller (PLC).
The physical programming of the BMS can occur at Forney or the DCS suppliers location.
